diagnosticTests.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with ESR
diagnosticTests.preparationInstructions: No fasting required. Collect sterile venous blood.

diagnosticTests.name: Fasting Plasma Blood Glucose (FBS)
diagnosticTests.preparationInstructions: Overnight fasting of 8 to 10 hours required before collection.

diagnosticTests.name: Comprehensive Lipid Profile
diagnosticTests.preparationInstructions: Strict 10-12 hour fasting required. Avoid alcohol 24hr prior.

diagnosticTests.name: Liver Function Test (LFT Panel)
diagnosticTests.preparationInstructions: Fasting preferred for accurate Bilirubin and Enzyme evaluation.

diagnosticTests.name: Kidney Function Test (KFT / RFT)
diagnosticTests.preparationInstructions: Hydrate normally; avoid heavy strenuous exercise prior to test.

diagnosticTests.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG)
diagnosticTests.preparationInstructions: Wear loose clothing; avoid caffeine 2 hours prior.

diagnosticTests.name: Digital Chest X-Ray (PA View)
diagnosticTests.preparationInstructions: Remove jewelry, metal zippers, and piercings around chest.

diagnosticTests.name: 3.0T MRI Brain with Contrast Enhancement
diagnosticTests.preparationInstructions: Check for metallic implants, pacemakers, and provide Creatinine.
